excluded: CN my_region overlay deliberately NOT shipped. A root-level module file (my_region/build.prop) makes hybrid_mount take its 'shallow overlay' path for /my_region: it mounts an overlay on /my_region and then bind-mounts a staging etc over /my_region/etc. ZygiskNext later unmounts module mounts inside the zygote/system_server namespace, exposing that staging etc, so /my_region/etc is EMPTY for system_server - confirmed by 'CustomizeStateHelper: No directory /my_region/etc/extension' and 'OplusAppConfigManager: No directory /my_region/etc/config' in the same process at the same instant. With /my_region/etc/config/app_v2.xml unreadable, the region <enable pkg=com.coloros.sceneservice priority=9> never enters enableMap, the my_stock <disable ... priority=10> survives reconciliation, and com.coloros.sceneservice is dropped from the PMS boot scan entirely ('locate /product/priv-app/SceneService/SceneService.apk ignored'), so it disappears from pm list. The overlay was also useless: init loads ro.* props before KernelSU mounts, so a bind-mounted my_region/build.prop cannot change the region, and OsFeatureConfiguration read the extension XMLs at 08:18:32, before hybrid_mount applied overlays at 08:18:37. CN UMS 16.59.6 and CN SceneService 17.6.0 are also not overlaid: UMS keeps a /data/app 17.17.0 update that PMS prefers anyway, and overlaying SceneService only re-adds the blacklist problem above. All privapp-permissions XMLs are still shipped (harmless).
